globalStyle.voice: @me verified avatar voice (identical pitch, tone, accent in every clip)
globalStyle.outfit: crisp white shirt and black blazer (identical in every scene)
globalStyle.background: solid plain seamless mid-grey studio background with soft even lighting and nothing else in the frame
globalStyle.gestures: Standing still in the same spot, natural calm hand gestures kept below chest level
globalStyle.audio: @me verified avatar voice ONLY, continuous speech filling the full 10 seconds at a brisk explainer pace, NO background music, NO silence at start or end
globalStyle.negativePrompts: Avatar stays centered in the foreground with face and body fully visible at all times; NO objects, icons, graphics or props anywhere in the frame; NO text on screen, NO captions, NO name tags, NO logos, NO outfit change, NO camera cut, NO tripod, NO camera or microphone or any studio equipment visible in frame, nothing in front of the avatar
globalStyle.camera: Locked-off static shot, medium close-up framed from chest up, avatar centered in frame at the same size in every scene, eye level, 50mm lens look, no zoom, no pan, no camera movement; the camera itself is never visible
globalStyle.realism: Photorealistic live-action footage of a real human presenter recorded in one studio session, natural skin texture, natural eye contact and accurate lip sync, soft even key light from the front, identical exposure and white balance in every scene
globalStyle.delivery: Energetic educational explainer style, like a confident teacher: brisk pace, continuous speech, no long pauses, natural emphasis on key words; speak the dialogue exactly once, word for word, never repeat, stretch or slow down a word

scenes.dialogue: Hi, I am Ravi from LawWorld. Two cousins, a late-night card game, one sudden fatal blow. Is that murder, or something less? An appellate bench has drawn the line. Here is how.
scenes.visual3D: Ravi speaking to camera, same pose and framing as every other clip, plain grey background, no props, no graphics.
scenes.broll: Two stylised figures sit at a small card table under a night sky with a crescent moon; a large orange question mark rises between them and pulses.
scenes.brollRealistic: Two young men sit across a small wooden table playing cards in a dim rural courtyard at night under a crescent moon, lit by a single lantern, tense expressions, slow push-in.

scenes.dialogue: Picture a farm shed at night. Cousins and friends gather to guard the crops, and pass the time playing cards by a bonfire. Then one player accuses another of cheating.
scenes.visual3D: Ravi speaking to camera, same pose and framing as every other clip, plain grey background, no props, no graphics.
scenes.broll: A small farm shed beside rows of crops at night; four simple figures play cards around a glowing bonfire; one figure suddenly stands and points an accusing finger at another.
scenes.brollRealistic: A rural farm shed beside rows of crops at night; four young men sit around a crackling bonfire playing cards; one stands up and points angrily at another while the others look up in surprise.

scenes.dialogue: Words fly and the two are pulled apart. As his cousin walks away, the accused follows and strikes once, a single wound to the abdomen. The cousin dies in hospital.
scenes.visual3D: Ravi speaking to camera, same pose and framing as every other clip, plain grey background, no props, no graphics.
scenes.broll: Two figures are held apart by friends with angry speech bubbles; one walks away along a path, the other follows; a single red burst flashes; then a hospital building with a fading heartbeat line.
scenes.brollRealistic: Two friends hold back an angry young man beside a bonfire at night while another man walks away along a dirt path into the dark; the angry man follows him; then the exterior of a small hospital at night with a slowly flashing ambulance light.

scenes.dialogue: The trial court called it murder and gave a life term. On appeal, the defence attacked the delay in registering the case, the relatives as witnesses, and the darkness at the scene.
scenes.visual3D: Ravi speaking to camera, same pose and framing as every other clip, plain grey background, no props, no graphics.
scenes.broll: A courthouse with columns; three floating icons appear one by one beside it: a clock, a small group of linked family figures, and a dark crescent-moon night icon.
scenes.brollRealistic: The exterior of a grand colonial-era courthouse with stone columns at dusk, slow cinematic crane shot; then a brass wall clock; then a moonlit dark farm field.

scenes.dialogue: Delay? The first phone call to the police was cryptic, with no names and no details. Settled law says a cryptic call is not a first information report. The delay explained itself.
scenes.visual3D: Ravi speaking to camera, same pose and framing as every other clip, plain grey background, no props, no graphics.
scenes.broll: An old telephone rings with a speech bubble that contains only vague squiggles; the bubble is stamped with a red cross; then a clock hand sweeps calmly around its face.
scenes.brollRealistic: Close-up of an old rotary telephone ringing on a worn wooden desk in a dim office at night; a hand lifts the receiver; slow rack focus to a wall clock whose hands sweep calmly.

scenes.dialogue: Relatives as witnesses? The bench reminded us: a close relative is the last person to shield the real culprit and blame an innocent man. Their consistent accounts carried a ring of truth.
scenes.visual3D: Ravi speaking to camera, same pose and framing as every other clip, plain grey background, no props, no graphics.
scenes.broll: A family tree of linked figure icons; three of them light up in orange and speak with matching speech bubbles; a green tick appears over them while a shadowy figure is pushed aside.
scenes.brollRealistic: A close-knit rural family of three generations standing together in front of their farmhouse at golden hour, looking calmly and sincerely toward the viewer, gentle wind, slow dolly-in.

scenes.dialogue: Darkness? A bonfire, a torch, and a lamp lit the scene. Villagers see well by such light, and these men had known each other for years. Identification, the bench held, was credible.
scenes.visual3D: Ravi speaking to camera, same pose and framing as every other clip, plain grey background, no props, no graphics.
scenes.broll: A dark night scene brightens as a bonfire, a hand-held torch beam and a hanging lantern switch on one after another, revealing four familiar figures who wave to each other.
scenes.brollRealistic: A dark village night that gradually brightens as a bonfire flares up, a hand-held torch beam sweeps across, and a hanging lantern is lit, revealing four men who recognise each other and nod.

scenes.dialogue: But was it murder? No premeditation, a sudden quarrel in the heat of passion, one blow, no cruelty. That is Exception Four: culpable homicide not amounting to murder, not murder itself.
scenes.visual3D: Ravi speaking to camera, same pose and framing as every other clip, plain grey background, no props, no graphics.
scenes.broll: A large balance beam tilts: on one side a stormy red anger burst with a single lightning strike, on the other a calm blue clock; the beam settles gently toward the calm side.
scenes.brollRealistic: Antique brass balance scales on a dark wooden desk in a wood-panelled chamber; one pan slowly lowers and settles; warm lamp light, floating dust motes, slow push-in.

scenes.dialogue: So the life sentence became ten years of rigorous imprisonment. The lesson: the law weighs the moment, not just the outcome. Follow LawWorld to master the evolving law, explained in ninety seconds!
scenes.visual3D: Ravi speaking to camera, same pose and framing as every other clip, plain grey background, no props, no graphics.
scenes.broll: A tall stack of calendar pages shrinks to a shorter stack; prison bars slide partly open; a big orange check mark bounces in beside a small forward arrow.
scenes.brollRealistic: A wall calendar with its pages flipping quickly in time-lapse; then a heavy iron gate slowly opening onto bright sunlight as a young man walks out toward the light, seen from behind.

brollSetting: Set in a rural village in Kerala, South India: all people are South Indian, wearing simple everyday cotton clothes, with tropical greenery, coconut palms and tiled or thatched roofs in the surroundings
